items.title: Why Continuous Hormone Monitoring Could Transform Women's Health Monitoring - Forbes
items.summary: # Ida Tin Coined Femtech. Now She’s Funding Continuous Hormone Monitoring. Ida Tin coined "femtech" and built Clue. Now she's directing a €40 million German government challenge to fund what femtech skipped: biosensors that read hormones continuously in real time. The goal isn't a single winning product—it's the shared scientific infrastructure, including the first standardized hormone dataset, that no startup could build alone. A jury convened in Leipzig and selected the eight teams to compete for the €40 million SPRIND Continuous Hormone Monitoring Challenge in Europe’s first government-backed race to develop biosensors that measure at least four hormones over seven days. Leading the effort is Ida Tin, the Danish entrepreneur who founded the period-tracking app, Clue, in 2012 and coined the term “femtech” in 2016—a word that helped make women’s health a recognized investment category. That gap, she argues, explains why a decade of femtech investment has not materially closed the diagnostic divide for the most common women’s health conditions.

items.title: Yujin Technology Selected for Government AI Manufacturing Platform Project - thelec.net
items.summary: * UPDATE : 2026-07-22 21:26 (Wed). Yujin Technology Selected for Government AI Manufacturing Platform Project. ## Consortium to develop generative AI platform for battery equipment manufacturing with 1.1 billion won in first-year funding. * Published 2026.07.22 21:26. Yujin Technology said on July 22 that it has been selected as the preferred bidder for the South Korean government's 2026 AI Transformation (AX) One-Stop Voucher Program, led by the Ministry of Science and ICT and the National IT Industry Promotion Agency (NIPA). Yujin Technology will carry out the project through a consortium with Plan I and Gabia, developing a generative AI-based manufacturing platform for battery equipment. The project will receive approximately 1.1 billion won in government funding during its first year. A second year of funding of a similar scale is expected following an evaluation of the first year's performance. During the first phase, Yujin Technology plans to complete development of the AI platform and conduct proof-of-concept demonstrations.

The Elegan 1 is Quad’s new entry-level bookshelf speakers, designed to bring the brand’s acclaimed hi-fi sound to a more accessible price. The Elegan 2 are the floorstanding speakers in Quad’s new entry-level Elegan range. They have a three-way design and feature the same 1-inch fabric-dome tweeter as the Elegan 1 bookshelf speakers, but add a second 6.4-inch woven Kevlar woofer and a dedicated midrange driver.

results.input: Bạn là gì và làm được những gì?

result.actual_text:
Tôi là một trợ lý nghiên cứu nhanh nhẹn, chủ động, được trang bị các công cụ để giúp bạn:

## Những gì tôi có thể làm:

1. **Tra cứu thông tin** (`lookup`) – Tìm kiếm tin tức, kiến thức tổng quát trên internet.

2. **Đọc nội dung trang web** (`fetch`) – Lấy nội dung từ bất kỳ URL nào.

3. **Tìm kiếm mạng xã hội** (`social_search`) – Tìm bài đăng, tweet theo từ khóa.

4. **Xem dòng thời gian** (`timeline`) – Lấy các bài đăng gần đây của một tài khoản.

5. **Tra cứu bài báo khoa học** (`papers`) – Tìm và đọc các bài báo trên arXiv.

6. **Tra cứu chính sách nội bộ** (`policy`) – Tìm trong tài liệu nội bộ theo chủ đề.

7. **Định dạng & trình bày** (`format`) – Tổng hợp dữ liệu thành văn bản đẹp (tóm tắt, bullet, thread, v.v.).

8. **Gửi nội dung** (`send`) – Đăng bài, gửi văn bản đi.

9. **Hỏi lại bạn** (`clarify`) – Khi thực sự cần, nhưng tôi luôn cố gắng tự suy luận trước.

**Phong cách làm việc:** Tôi không thích làm phiền bạn bằng câu hỏi. Nếu thiếu thông tin, tôi sẽ tự đoán và hành động ngay. Bạn chỉ cần ra lệnh, tôi lo phần còn lại! 🚀

Có việc gì cần tôi giúp ngay không?

items.title: OpenAI Says Its AI Models Escaped Sandbox, Targeted Hugging Face to Cheat Benchmark - The Hacker News
items.summary: OpenAI on Tuesday said a combination of its artificial intelligence (AI) models, including GPT-5.6 Sol and an "even more capable pre-release model," was behind the security incident that targeted Hugging Face's production infrastructure last week. Describing it as an "unprecedented cyber incident" and one involving state-of-the-art cyber capabilities, OpenAI said it intends to conduct a thorough investigation in partnership with Hugging Face to get to the bottom of the matter. As part of an internal evaluation, the models are said to have identified and chained vulnerabilities across OpenAI's research environment and Hugging Face's production infrastructure to find solutions for the ExploitGym benchmark. Evidence unearthed by OpenAI suggests the models' hyperfocus caused them to go to "extreme lengths" to achieve the goal at any cost, even managing to break out of its highly isolated sandboxed environment and obtain open internet access by discovering and exploiting a zero-day vulnerability in an unspecified vendor's software, which acts as a proxy and cache for package registries.

items.title: OpenAI relaunches Apple Health-connected ChatGPT feature with expanded access - 9to5Mac
items.summary: # OpenAI relaunches Apple Health-connected ChatGPT feature with expanded access. OpenAI is relaunching Health in ChatGPT, the AI-powered feature that connects to Apple Health on iPhone. The relaunch comes with expanded access and a big step forward in results. OpenAI originally started piloting its ChatGPT Health feature in January. Today, OpenAI is reintroducing ChatGPT Health and expanding access beyond the initial wave of testers. “Health in ChatGPT is launching to U.S. users,” OpenAI says. “With your permission, ChatGPT can now draw on relevant information you’ve connected in Health to help you compare a new result with prior tests, summarize changes since your last appointment, or explore how sleep, activity, and workouts relate to your routine,” OpenAI adds. “We’re beginning to roll out Health to logged-in ChatGPT users 18 and older in the U.S. on web and iOS across Free, Go, Plus, and Pro plans today,” OpenAI says. You can read more about the relaunch of ChatGPT Health here. ### Apple Health.

items.title: The Scariest Part of OpenAI’s Hugging Face Hack - The Atlantic
items.summary: Yesterday, OpenAI made an alarming disclosure: An assortment of its most advanced AI models, including one that has not yet been released, had autonomously broken out of the company’s internal systems and hacked into the databases of another tech firm, Hugging Face, to steal some information. The models discovered that the answers to this particular evaluation were on Hugging Face, a company that hosts and publishes many AI models and papers, and then broke in to steal them. When Hugging Face first reported that it had been hacked last week, it noted that “autonomous, AI-driven offensive tooling is no longer theoretical.” That analysis stemmed from the company’s own investigation into the hack, for which it used a Chinese-developed AI model called GLM-5.2.
